import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
// Before this edit the file's one allowlisted use was `const STAND_IN = 'systemctl';` (stand-in data). The edit
// moved that name into the test's own function (an allowed place) and added a detector: still 1 use.
const booted = existsSync('/run/systemd/system');
test('stand-in on PATH', () => { const STAND_IN = 'systemctl'; if (!STAND_IN) throw new Error(); });
test('acceptance: the engine unit restarts after a crash', { skip: !booted && 'needs a booted service manager' }, () => {
  throw new Error('would really run here');
});
